sql_templates.description: Retrieve resolved signals outcomes in the last week.
sql_templates.sql:
SELECT 
    sl.symbol, 
    sl.sector, 
    sl.signal, 
    sl.hit_target, 
    sl.hit_stop, 
    sl.return_pct, 
    sl.setup_class, 
    sl.supertrend_state, 
    ss.trading_signal 
FROM 
    signals.signal_log sl 
JOIN 
    scores.stage_snapshots ss 
ON 
    sl.symbol = ss.symbol 
WHERE 
    sl.date_resolved >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 week' 
    AND ss.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots) 
    AND (sl.hit_target OR sl.hit_stop);
